mapper.select: SELECT l.*, m.material_name, m.spec as specification, b.batch_no, w.node_name as warehouse_name FROM spd_label l LEFT JOIN spd_material m ON l.material_id = m.material_id LEFT JOIN spd_material_batch b ON l.batch_id = b.batch_id LEFT JOIN spd_org_node w ON l.warehouse_id = w.node_id WHERE l.label_code = #{labelCode} AND l.del_flag = #{delFlag}
